cohort: 360 umbilical cord blood samples were collected from pregnant women at Tongji Hospital in Wuhan, China between October 2017 and August 2018, with an average maternal age of 29.5 years (range 19-48 years) and gestational ages ranging from 28+4 weeks to 41+3 weeks.
finding: Combined traditional parameters and aUCBG measurements improved the prediction of neonatal condition, particularly in high-risk pregnancies, including those with lower Apgar scores, preterm delivery, and maternal age above 35 years.
